state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors define an EXAMINER LM that evaluates claims generated by an EXAMINEE LM by asking questions aimed at revealing inconsistencies with the examinee's initial claim. Such inconsistencies are treated as a signal of the examinee's uncertainty in its claim and used to judge whether the claim is correct.
title: Examiner and examinee roles in LM cross-examination
